name: Filmora
price: Free version; Basic US$49.99/yr, Advanced US$59.99/yr, Premium US$99.99/yr (billed yearly); perpetual license also available
watermark: Watermarked on free exports; paid plans remove the watermark
bestFor: Editors who want a desktop timeline close to CapCut and will pay once a year for clean exports
notFor: Anyone who needs a free, watermark-free export
limits: Free version exports with a watermark. Watermark-free export is a paid feature; the tier comparison splits AI assets, effects, and export options across Basic, Advanced, and Premium. Resellers and regional stores price these differently.
